review.notes: All 30 bilingual entries read in full with native concatenation. Neuter product wrappers support all generic item pronouns; requester labels support either NPC gender without inflecting the inserted display name. Twelve body parts include complete locative phrases and possessives, composing with εντριβές without singular/plural agreement problems. Fixed-price, cash, urgency and triple-market-price distinctions retained.
